latestVersion.changelog:
LEGO Pixel Art Generator v1.0.0

- Launch of a tool to convert any image into LEGO brick pixel art with a custom building plan and purchase list.
- Supports standard LEGO color system (36 colors), custom build sizes (10–200 studs), and adjustable color precision.
- Generates a row-by-row building guide and complete material list, ready for export or copying.
- Pure frontend, dependency-free, out-of-the-box solution for enthusiasts, creators, and educators.
- Includes an interactive tool for easy upload, live parameter adjustment, and real-time preview.
